name: toast
description: A source-owned Toast notification system for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Only the toast region's fixed viewport placement is styled by default (structural, not cosmetic); individual toast cards keep the primitive's own unstyled composition, matching this registry's existing many-parts-unstyled precedent for Select/Combobox. A full default visual style for Toast itself is M4's job.
